article_visual_assets.text_policy: ComfyUI generates text-free media only; Remotion adds all readable text.
article_visual_assets.prompt_policy: Creative prompts describe what the image should express: semantic anchor, emotion, metaphor, material, light, composition and art language. Symbols appear when they grow from the script's imagery and can explain their meaning. Text-bearing subject terms such as phrase, note, notebook, page, document, tag, label, typography, editorial layout or idea table require prompt_review text_risk_mitigation and should be translated into blank cards, pure material surfaces, color fields, light paths, object arrays or geometric hierarchy before GPU generation.
article_visual_assets.cross_episode_repeat_policy: Extract fresh imagery from this script using: 脑内电视, 两个频道, 遥控器, 临时节目单; do not mechanically copy prominent motifs from recent episodes.

wan_policy.extension_policy: If the chosen scene stays on screen longer than the generated Wan clip, Remotion extends the motion with playbackRate, tail hold and subtle still motion rather than requesting a longer Wan generation.
